name: Add to Collection or Playlist
definition: User wants to add a track, album, artist, or other content to a personal collection or playlist.

name: Rate Item
definition: User wants to assign a rating or score to an item.

name: Play Media
definition: User wants to play music, a playlist, or other audio/visual content.

name: Book Reservation
definition: User wants to book a table, room, or other reservation at a venue.

name: Find Media Content
definition: User wants to locate a specific movie, show, book, soundtrack, or picture.

name: Get Weather Information
definition: User wants to know the weather forecast or current conditions.

name: Find Venue or Event
definition: User wants to locate a specific type of venue or an event.

name: Get Item Information
definition: User wants to find specific details about an item.
